blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Safeguards investor interests against unfair and fraudulent practices.
Fosters the growth and development of the securities market.
Imposes regulations on stock exchanges and financial intermediaries.
Establishes transparency across all trading systems.
Curbs market manipulation and prevents illegal insider trading.

blocks.content: • Promote development of the securities market.
• Regulate stock exchanges and financial intermediaries.

items: SEBI's three primary objectives are broadly categorized into Protective, Regulatory, and Developmental functions.
Prevention of insider trading and market manipulation is a frequently tested protective objective.
Regulating stock exchanges and market intermediaries forms a key component of SEBI's regulatory powers.
